tabmat_geometry.design: One fresh process per method; one whole-geometry warmup and three within-process repetitions. Geometry diagnostic only, not independent complete-fit repetitions or a complete-fit speed claim.
tabmat_geometry.timed_scope: Worker encloses geometry construction, eta, likelihood derivatives, score, curvature channels and owned output creation; raw packing, CSR/CSC conversion and writable channel copies included. Common fixture/compilation outside geometry clocks; total-process RSS includes imports, fixture, warmup and repetitions.
tabmat_geometry.interpretation: Raw constructor-inclusive whole-geometry runs were slower than both grouped and panels in this bounded diagnostic. No individual constructor subphase timings were collected, so no attribution of the loss to an individual packing/conversion step is established. No full-fit adaptation or complete-fit speed claim follows.
tabmat_geometry.limits: One fresh worker per method, with one whole-geometry warmup and three within-process repetitions. Fixture compilation, solver iterations, line search and terminal inference are outside geometry clocks. Array estimates exclude Python allocator and common family arrays. No complete-fit speed claim or full-fit tabmat adaptation follows.

final_default_campaign.order: Per-case baseline exact/discrete, candidate exact/discrete; reverse alternate repetitions. Witness phase candidate discrete only.
final_default_campaign.warmup_policy: Fresh process for every worker; standard public warmup precedes clocks; inherited caches retained. Fit process RSS includes imports, fixture, warmup and fit. Output/representation highwater recorded separately.
final_default_campaign.cpu_caveat: Endpoint accounting is a lower bound: CPU used after a process's last observation before exit, and by processes born and exited between snapshots, is unavailable. Newly observed processes contribute all observed lifetime ticks; PID reuse is distinguished by start ticks. Descendants that reparent between snapshots may not be identifiable. This is a screening check, not proof that the machine stayed quiet throughout a fit.
final_default_campaign.comparison_policy: Source-to-source comparisons retain the same representation separately for exact and discrete. Candidate exact/discrete differences describe representation effects: finite support may be lossless, continuous inputs may be binned. Small discrepancies alone do not prove exact equivalence.
final_default_campaign.witness_metadata_note: The raw capture field timed_instrumentation describes the timing-phase protocol even in witness captures. Witnesses are identified by instrumented=true and enabled=true instrumentation with actual counters; no witness time is used in the fit aggregates.
